“ I'm going to bring this yakgwa back for the Sugar Swan! „

Yakgwa Delivery Envoy (Korean: ) is Blue Slushy Cookie's third Costume, released in the first half of the Return of Yakgwa Village: Haunting Tales update. It is an Epic Costume that can be obtained by purchasing it with Gold Gems in the Gem Exchange Center during the Return of Yakgwa Village: Haunting Tales update.

Story

Today's mission: Bring delicious treats from Yakgwa Village all the way back to Dessert Paradise! Blue Slushy Cookie takes on this crucial mission with pride, even topping her icing with a special feathered hat marking her as a Dessert Guardian. One glance across Yakgwa Village reveals countless new, fascinating things to see—from clothing carefully crafted from honey and flour to eye-catching fan dance performances paired with music to make any Cookie's dough move! The Dessert Guardian's eyes sparkle as she explores the village until sundown.

Trivia

  • Yakgwa Village Envoy was released alongside  Yakgwa Delivery Envoy,  Piquant General Shaman and  Jakdu Headbutt.

Name in Other Languages

Korean

디저트 숲의 엘프가 된
(dijeoteu sup-ui elpeuga doen)

“ Here to join the journey... Adventure? Trip? What was my line...? „

Dessert Forest Elf (Korean: 디저트 숲의 엘프가 된, dijeoteu sup-ui elpeuga doen) is Blue Slushy Cookie's second Costume, released in the first half of the Lights, Camera, Action! update. It is a Rare Costume that could be obtained either by drawing it from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop during the limited season period that it was available.

Story

Get ready for the fantasy film of the year, The Fellowship of the Jelly. It's about a journey to rid the One Jelly that will taint the world with wickedness. Taking on the role of an elf from the Dessert Forest is none other than Blue Slushy Cookie. While giving it her all on set because "acting is in her nature," there's a slight hiccup! It turns out that shooting rubber arrows a bit too high makes them stick to the lights. Let's aim a little lower next time!

Trivia

  • Dessert Forest Elf was released alongside  Gunfight at the O.Cake Corral,  Cheese Mine Dwarf,  Icon of the Age, On-set Dynamo On-set Dynamo,  Cinematic Songster, A Fan's Perspective A Fan's Perspective, and  O.Cake Corral Doctor.
  • Dessert Forest Elf and  Cheese Mine Dwarf were the first Rare Costumes that could be purchased with Rainbow Crystals.
    • They are currently the only limited Special Season Rare Costumes.
  • Dessert Forest Elf, alongside  Cheese Mine Dwarf, is a reference to the film, The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring.

“ Sugar Swan came back... It's like I'm dreaming... „

Glacial Waltz (Korean: ) is Blue Slushy Cookie's first Costume, released accompanying her in the first half of the Trip to Paradise update. It is a Super Epic Costume that can be obtained either by drawing it from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop.

Story

Meet Blue Slushy Cookie, now graced with the wings of a true guardian. Wearing lavender shoes, she soars over the lake, making ice pillars rise up with little stars. The movement of this dream-fulfilled bird resemble a joyful waltz!

Trivia

  • Glacial Waltz was released alongside  Pampered with Persimmon,  Butterfly Fairy's Ballet,  Honey Rice Cake, and  Waltz of Ice Sculptures.
